prompt:
Generate ONE production background illustration for a mobile "Memory Post Office" keepsake album. Reference image is STYLE AND ENVIRONMENT reference only, not an image to preserve text/UI from. Deliver portrait 1024 x 1408 pixels (aspect 8:11), no transparency. Faithfully retain the reference's beautiful warm detailed hand-painted cozy game environment, cream plaster walls, honey-colored wooden desk, forest green/teal wood window frame at upper right with sunny terracotta village and blue river outside, deep green POST mailbox on right, small brass postal hand-stamp on left and sparse white daisies at edges. Warm late-morning sunlight, tactile cream paper and sage green envelope lining, refined gentle shadows, premium storybook illustration without plastic 3D rendering.

COMPOSITION FOR REAL HTML OVERLAY, crucial:
- Top 0 to 34 percent of the whole image is bright low-detail cream wall across the left and center, with the window mostly at the far right. This empty area will hold a brand, title, chapter line and search field. DO NOT DRAW THESE.
- An open large cream-paper envelope dominates the lower center. Its triangular flap tip is at x50%, y42%. Its open mouth/green lining is around y58%. Envelope reaches x4% and x96%.
- The rectangle from x4% to96%, y56% to85% is intentionally ONLY sage green lining / envelope paper / desk, ready to be covered by a real landscape keepsake card in HTML. DO NOT DRAW ANY CARD, human, character, lettering, image frame, label, text, stamp contents or UI here.
- Bottom 85–100% continues the warm wooden desktop and a small edge of a green desk mat, subtle edge flowers; NO large foreground occluder.
- Envelope flap may have a faint circular postal mark with simple village silhouettes and wave lines but no text inside. The word POST on the mailbox is the ONLY text in entire image.

Remove all reference card imagery, people, logos, brand text, title, subtitles, chapter words, Lesson numbers, thumbnails, buttons, navigation, mobile chrome, device frame, status bars. Absolutely no UI anywhere. This is only the environment behind actual existing original GIF cards and real interactive controls. Keep the environment art direction extremely close to the reference, no modern empty app-like image or new palette.
notes: Only environment asset. Original award cards are not generated or altered; real GIFs must be rendered on top in HTML.
